items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: And then comes me and then come Ida, Ida's the baby girls.

ctx.x: Did you explain that, were you about the third sister or how, were the others older, how many were older than you?
Well, Sadie older than you? Sadie and Edna older and I, see. And then comes me and then come Ida, Ida's the baby girls.
Did your father or mother ever play in any bands or? No, they never did.

items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Yeah, well, that's Willie, Edmund, and Sadie. Three of them play piano.

ctx.x: Oh yes. I have four more sisters. I mean, well, three more sisters plays piano. Living now.
Yeah, well, that's Willie, Edmund, and Sadie. Three of them play piano.
I'm the fourth one. All living. And there are some that have passed, aren't there? Well, yes, I have three passed. Two of them played, but the one passed while she was small. She was a baby Maggie.

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I worked with all of my sisters.

ctx.x: In fact, I worked with, I worked with Artie, your sister. Yeah, you worked with, I worked with you.
I worked with all of my sisters.
